line_evidence.text: A4.3.5 Describe how learning techniques using the association rule are used to uncover relations
between different attributes in large data sets.
• Mining techniques using the association rule and interpretation of the results for a given scenario
For example, in crime analysis, the techniques may reveal that areas with high rates of vandalism also often
experience incidents of theft, assisting law enforcement in predictive policing and resource allocation.
